Your crew are Phil on weather, Rita producing, and Larry on camera. Choose one physical action for this period. You may speak while carrying out any action, or stay silent. Return a JSON object with action, words, intention and detail. action must be one available action. words is a brief line you actually say. intention is an optional practical next plan. detail is empty unless you send one exact available assignment signal. Only physical actions change position or produce work.
